new_spots.name: The Chasm
new_spots.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim: The Chasm viewpoint (tourism=viewpoint) -44.72150,167.94774; Wikivoyage Milford Road -44.7216,167.9476
new_spots.bio: A 20-minute return bush walk off the Milford Road ends at the Cleddau River, where the water pours through and over rock sculpted into basins and hollows.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded DOC page; title 'The Chasm Walk: Fiordland National Park', states 400 m return, 20 min

new_spots.name: Key Summit
new_spots.bio: A side trip from the Routeburn Track at The Divide climbs above the bushline to an alpine wetland with views of the Darran Mountains and the Hollyford Valley.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: DOC has no separate Key Summit page reachable (URL guess redirected to park page); left null

photo.file: View from Key Summit across tarns.jpg

new_spots.name: Lake Marian
new_spots.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim: Hinepipiwai / Lake Marian -44.78599,168.07659; Wikipedia -44.785,168.075 (lake is the destination; trailhead is Lake Marian carpark 1 km down Hollyford Road)
new_spots.bio: A 3.1 km track from Hollyford Road climbs past a series of waterfalls to an alpine lake in a glacier-carved hanging valley, about 1 hr 30 min each way.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded DOC page; title 'Lake Marian Track: Fiordland National Park', 3.1 km, 1 hr 30 min one way

photo.file: View across Lake Marian up the valley.jpg

new_spots.name: Manapōuri
new_spots.bio: A lakeside township 20 minutes from Te Anau where tourist boats based on Lake Manapouri set out for Doubtful Sound and the start of local walking tracks.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: DOC 'Lake Manapouri area' page loaded but is an area page, not an official site for the township; left null

new_spots.name: Bowen Falls
new_spots.bio: At 162 m the tallest permanent waterfall to pour into Milford Sound, reached from the wharf by a short on-demand boat hop and a walk.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No official page for the falls; boat service price not sourced so cost omitted

photo.file: Lady Bowen Falls. Milford Sound NZ (31091105904).jpg

new_spots.name: Te Anau Bird Sanctuary
new_spots.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim: Te Anau Bird Sanctuary / Punanga Manu o Te Anau (tourism=zoo) -45.43265,167.71334; Wikivoyage -45.43302,167.71324
new_spots.bio: A free DOC sanctuary on the shore of Lake Te Anau where you can see the rare flightless takahe and other Fiordland birds hard to spot in the wild.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded DOC page; title 'Punanga Manu o Te Anau/Te Anau Bird Sanctuary: Features'; says open and free in daylight hours

new_spots.name: Hollyford Track
new_spots.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Hollyford Track coordinates -44.6928,168.1258 (northern, Hollyford Road end); OSM path node -44.5607,168.1264
new_spots.bio: A 56 km, 4 to 5 day tramp from the Darran Mountains down the Hollyford Valley to Martins Bay on the West Coast, with no alpine sections so it is rarely closed by snow.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded DOC page; title 'Hollyford Track: Fiordland National Park', 56 km one way, 4-5 days

new_spots.name: Pop's View Lookout
new_spots.bio: A roadside lookout on the Milford Road above the Hollyford Valley, with long views of the towering mountains along the valley.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No official page loaded whose title names the place; left null

photo.file: View From Hollyford Valley Lookout (Pops View) in Fiordland National Park (4687492931).jpg

new_spots.name: Monkey Creek
new_spots.bio: A roadside stop on the Milford Road at a mountain stream, known for chances to spot kea and blue duck.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No official page loaded whose title names the place; left null

new_spots.name: Lake Gunn
new_spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Milford Road: Cascade Creek, start of Lake Gunn Nature Walk -44.8949,168.0835; OSM lake -44.88842,168.07847
new_spots.bio: A beech-forest lake in the Eglinton Valley with an easy 45-minute loop walk from Cascade Creek through red beech forest and birdlife.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded DOC page; title 'Lake Gunn Nature Walk: Fiordland National Park', 1.4 km loop, 45 min

photo.file: Lake Gunn in Fiordland National Park.jpg

new_spots.name: Sutherland Falls
new_spots.bio: At 580 m one of New Zealand's tallest waterfalls, dropping in three cascades from Lake Quill, reached by a 90-minute return side walk from Quintin Shelter on the Milford Track.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No separate official page; left null

new_spots.name: Lake Mistletoe
new_spots.bio: An easy, short forest walk from the Milford Road leads to a small, peaceful lake near Te Anau Downs.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded DOC page; title 'Lake Mistletoe Track: Fiordland National Park', easy short walk from Milford Road
